_meta.description: Hand-curated supply chain + capital flow intelligence seed. Covers consumer staples (cocoa, coffee, sugar, palm oil, cans, glass, paperboard, grains, dairy, meat, CO2, distribution, private label), tech (wafers, photoresist, EUV, neon, rare earths, cobalt, lithium, assembly, CoWoS, HBM, optical, CDN, hyperscaler compute), energy (OPEC, shale, LNG, uranium, rigs, solar), and healthcare (API, plasma, GLP-1, vials, CDMO, distribution, devices).

confidence_legend.confirmed: Directly stated in a 10-K, 20-F, annual report, or regulator filing
confidence_legend.derived: Pieced together from multiple public disclosures (segment + geo + customer list)
confidence_legend.estimated: Reasonable back-of-envelope from public data (e.g. revenue * segment pct)
confidence_legend.inferred: Directional only (no hard number, but relationship is real and well-sourced)

nodes.name: Cocoa beans
nodes.notes: Top producers: Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana, Ecuador, Cameroon, Nigeria. ~70% from West Africa.

nodes.name: Coffee beans
nodes.notes: Top producers: Brazil (~40% arabica), Vietnam (~45% robusta), Colombia, Ethiopia, Indonesia.

nodes.name: Palm oil
nodes.notes: 85% of global supply from Indonesia + Malaysia.

nodes.name: Food-grade CO2
nodes.notes: Byproduct of ammonia/ethanol plants. Periodic shortages (2022 Jackson Dome contamination).

nodes.name: EUV lithography tool
nodes.notes: ASML is the only supplier. Full single-source chokepoint.

nodes.name: Semiconductor-grade neon gas
nodes.notes: Pre-2022 >70% of global supply came from Ukraine (Odesa + Mariupol air-separation units).

nodes.name: Rare earth oxides (NdPr, Dy, Tb)
nodes.notes: China controls ~85% of processing.

nodes.name: Cobalt
nodes.notes: ~70% of mine supply from DRC, ~75% of refining from China.

nodes.name: TSMC CoWoS advanced packaging
nodes.notes: Hard cap on H100/H200/B100 shipments through 2025.

nodes.name: HBM3/HBM3e memory stacks
nodes.notes: SK Hynix sold out through 2025, Micron 2024+ capacity sold.

nodes.name: Generic API (active pharma ingredient)
nodes.notes: India produces ~20% of global API, China ~40% of starting materials.

nodes.name: Human source plasma
